thread:
Maya (marketing): Quick sync — we need a clean benchmark narrative for the launch next Tue. Focus: latency vs $/token story + routing play. Ideas below, please react and iterate.

Devin (product): High-level: hero claim needs to be defensible. Can we say "X% lower cost at 99ms median"? Need numbers and test conditions.

Liam (data): Ran a quick run, results attached: median latency 88ms, p95 240ms on small-batch hosted model; cost per 1k tokens: $0.12 baseline vs $0.08 with batching+cache. Quick CSV:
```
scenario,median_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1k
baseline,120,300,0.12
batched,95,260,0.09
cached,88,240,0.08
```
Use these as straw numbers until we finalize.

Nora (eng): Important: define test payloads. I recommend: 1) short prompts (<=50 tokens) 2) medium (200-500) 3) long (1k+). Include cold vs warm cache. Also show fallback behavior. We should call out sequence lengths and hardware (A100-40GB) in appendix. :+1: 

Sam (design): For visuals I'd propose 3 tiers: hero sparkline (median latency vs cost), deep-dive scatter (per-request latency vs cost with SLA bands), and appendix waterfall for token-dollar breakdown. I can mock templates by EOD. Need color palette for SLA bands.

Alex (growth): Messaging: For top of funnel, keep hero: "Predictable LLM economics — faster at lower cost". For enterprise, add routing/SLAs paragraph. We'll split assets: social one-liners, blog copy, webinar slides. Also plan gated webinar for inbound routing.

Maya (marketing): Love it. Specific asks:
- Devin: claim phrasing + exact numbers by Fri
- Liam: sanitized CSV and a small chart-ready JSON
- Sam: hero/design + 2 variants (SaaS vs Enterprise)
- Nora: test matrix + short note on hardware
- Alex: webinar landing copy draft

bench-bot: perf-run #472 finished. Summary: 100k synthetic requests, 3 payload bins, A100. Key metrics: median=88ms, p95=240ms, avg cost delta=-32% vs baseline.

Devin (product): Let's avoid absolute % unless we can reproduce across regions. Maybe phrase as "up to 30% lower per-token cost in common production workloads" and footnote test conditions.

Liam (data): I'll produce region-sliced numbers + small mock Vega snippet by Thu. Snippet:
```
{ "data": { "values": [
  {"scenario":"baseline","x":120,"y":0.12},
  {"scenario":"cached","x":88,"y":0.08}
]}}
```

Nora (eng): Also add a chart comparing tail latency with and without prefix/KV cache — that's a big sell.

Sam (design): Noted. Two colorways: SaaS (blue/green) and Enterprise (navy/amber). Will upload SVGs to Figma link: https://figma.com/redwood/bench-orbit

Maya (marketing): Webinar plan quick draft: 20 min demo (prefetch/prefix cache), 20 min deep-dive (charts + Q&A), call-to-action: 14-day dedicated trial or consult. Assign: Alex (land), Nora (demo), Liam (data slide), Sam (slides).

Alex (growth): I'll draft landing page copy and form fields. Suggested lead routing: if org size >500 then route to AE, else SDR. Tag leads with 'bench-orbit' and region.

Maya (marketing): Great — try to have first asset set (hero + one deep-dive chart + landing draft) by Fri noon. Any blockers?

Devin (product): None on my end, will review numbers.

Nora (eng): Need test infra window Wed morning to run region sweep. I'll post calendly.

Maya (marketing): :rocket: thanks team. We'll reconvene Fri 11am to review assets. Please drop files here when ready.
